name: @samline/drawer
description: Framework-agnostic drawer runtime with a vanilla/browser API and an IIFE bundle for direct CDN use.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:package
scripts.site:build: node site-tools/assets.mjs && npm --workspace docs run build && npm --workspace landing run build && node site-tools/assemble.mjs && node site-tools/check-site.mjs && npm run site:check:migration
scripts.site:check: node site-tools/check-config.mjs && npm run site:check:design && npm --workspace landing run check && npm --workspace docs run check
scripts.site:format: prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --write landing docs/src docs/scripts shared site-tools site-tests site-e2e playwright.site.config.ts project.config.json content-audit.json design-reference.json SITE*.md --ignore-path .site-prettierignore
scripts.site:format:check: prettier --plugin prettier-plugin-astro --check landing docs/src docs/scripts shared site-tools site-tests site-e2e playwright.site.config.ts project.config.json content-audit.json design-reference.json SITE*.md --ignore-path .site-prettierignore
scripts.site:verify: npm run site:check && npm run site:format:check && npm run site:test && npm run site:test:adaptation && npm run site:build && npm run site:test:browser

author: Samuel Olvera (samline)
